title: Get side-by-side top AI model answers while lifetime Clearafi is just $49.99
content_html:
TL;DR: Get Clearafi AI Tier 1 lifetime access for $49.99 (reg. $299) for a limited time.

Credit: Clearafi

$49.99
$299 Save $249.01

An AI answer can sound convincing before you’ve had a chance to question it. Clearafi AI Tier 1 lifetime access is $49.99 (reg. $299) for a limited time, giving you a way to compare responses without pasting the same prompt into several chatbots.

Each consensus search uses two to three models from a lineup that includes Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Mistral, Kimi, and Cohere. You can review their answers side by side, alongside a synthesized response that brings together areas of agreement.

Clearafi also assigns a Consensus Score from 0 to 100 percent. Visual indicators show which claims receive agreement, partial support, or conflicting responses. That makes it easier to identify the parts of an answer worth investigating further.

Agreement between models isn’t proof that an answer is correct. The useful feature is transparency — seeing different responses and knowing where closer human review may be needed.

Beyond comparisons, the platform includes research and web search tools, writing assistance, image creation, and document features. You can work with PDFs, translate documents, generate presentations, and export verification reports in formats including PDF, Word, and CSV.

The Tier 1 allowance is 120 consensus queries per year, estimated using three-model searches, for the life of the product. That makes the plan worth considering for selected questions where multiple perspectives would help, rather than unlimited daily comparisons.

This offers a more visible review process with one upfront cost.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get Clearafi AI Tier 1 lifetime access for $49.99, and make room for another perspective before relying on the first answer.
